name: Apache ActiveMQ 6.3.2
body:
## What's Changed

### Performance
* [6.3.x] [#2431] Skip topic sendLock for non-persistent sends by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2476

### Fixes
* [6.3.x] [#] Update TopicRegion removeSubscription to use connection clientId by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2478
* [6.3.x] Harden soTimeout vs InactivityMonitor (#2474) by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2480
* [6.3.x] [#2446] Add missing jetty dependency to assembly for websockets by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2483
* [6.3.x] Fix network bridge local-side close (#2475) by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2503
* [6.3.x] Fix: Assembly startup logs harmless WARN about schemas (#2501) by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2504

### Dependencies
* [6.3.x] bump netty-version from 4.2.16.Final to 4.2.17.Final by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2442
* [6.3.x] bump org.apache.qpid:qpid-jms-client from 2.10.0 to 2.11.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2451
* [6.3.x] bump jolokia-version from 2.6.0 to 2.6.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2463
* [6.3.x] bump org.apache.groovy:groovy-ant from 5.0.8 to 5.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2466
* [6.3.x] bump org.apache.groovy:groovy from 5.0.8 to 5.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2467
* [6.3.x] bump io.fabric8:docker-maven-plugin from 0.48.1 to 0.49.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2456
* [6.3.x] bump camel-version from 4.21.0 to 4.22.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2448
* [6.3.x] bump jackson-version from 2.22.1 to 2.22.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2472
* [6.3.x] Update to Jetty 12.1.12 (#2470) by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2473
* [6.3.x] bump actions/stale from 10.4.0 to 11.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2294
* [6.3.x] bump spring-version from 7.0.8 to 7.0.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2484
* [6.3.x] bump actions/setup-java from 5 to 6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2492
* [6.3.x] bump org.javassist:javassist from 3.32.0-GA to 3.33.0-GA by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2490
* [6.3.x] bump org.apache.groovy:groovy-ant from 5.1.0 to 5.1.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2488
* [6.3.x] bump org.apache.groovy:groovy from 5.1.0 to 5.1.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2489

### Tasks
* KEYS: Add mattrpav@apache.org GPG release key (#2497) by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2498

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/apache/activemq/compare/activemq-6.3.1...activemq-6.3.2
